items.title: Richard McLean Interview, 1959-05-27
items.q: When I first went in the band, the clarinet player was Zeb

ctx.x: Ask a little bit more about René's band, who his clarinet player was? Could you tell us?

When I first went in the band, the clarinet player was Zeb, you call him, but what does Zeb, do you know his last name? I know his name but I just can't think of him. Most people don't even know, they just say Zeb until they know. I'll tell you who knows his name and remember his name, it's Happy. Yeah. And Joe René, his brother, the drum player. You said Morris French was the drummer. Morris French. I mean the trombone. Yeah, Morris French. Now his bass, the bass players, when I first went in the band, he had…
